bumpRationale: Tooling only: a dev-only visual preview harness (preview.html + src/preview/) that renders the real premium components against mock data for design review/screenshots, plus npm scripts (preview:dev, preview:shots) and a Playwright capture script. NavContext exported for the harness to mock; preview build entry gated behind PREVIEW so normal builds are unchanged. No production app behavior, API, or data changes.

assistantSkills.note: The sibling claude-skills repo holds 48 generic Anthropic/Claude authoring skills (pdf, xlsx, brainstorming, math-olympiad, ...). They are assistant tooling used to BUILD Liuma — NOT features of the application, not integrated into it, and not listed in the user manual.
